elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3.2.1 contains redacted placeholders rather than an operative USD 1,000,000 per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with a minimum aggregate limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3.2.1 contains a redacted placeholder for the Product and Completed Operations aggregate and does not state an operative USD 2,000,000 aggregate limit.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added SFJ provision requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance. The separate subcontractor provision has a redacted limit and does not cure the deficiency for SFJ itself.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added provision requires SFJ to maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance unconditionally, so the coverage trigger is not an issue, but the stated limit is only USD 2,000,000 rather than USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.
elements.evidence: No operative provision requires workers' compensation insurance. The introductory applicable-law standard governs the limits of the listed insurance types and does not add workers' compensation as a required coverage type.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance upon request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added provision states that SFJ will maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added provision states that SFJ will maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The rendered language reaches the complete fallback by adding operative SFJ obligations for USD 1,000,000 E&O and USD 2,000,000 cyber/privacy coverage. It does not reach the preferred position because the preferred CGL amounts remain redacted, E&O and cyber limits are below preferred levels, and workers' compensation and certificate-on-request duties are omitted. The change is limited to the fallback insurance requirements and does not alter unrelated commercial terms.
